results.reason: Issue 6 identifies automatic five-year Renewal Terms under SA §2.2 and the 240–270 day non-renewal window. It computes that window as roughly June 4 to July 4, 2026 (about 30 days) and says it has closed. It explains that missing it means renewal for five years to about March 2032.

Issue 5 identifies the worldwide, all-glass-and-PET, any-beverage exclusivity in SA §3.1. It contrasts this with TS §2.1's amber beer bottles at U.S./Canadian facilities and states that SA §15.1 supersedes the term sheet, so the broader text binds.

Issues 1 and 7 cite Recital C (receipt August 3, 2026) and the 30-day objection period ending September 2, 2026, before the September 21 Amendment. They conclude the increase is deemed accepted under SA §5.4.

Issue 2 explains that Amend. §2.1 replaces §11.2, removes recall costs from the carve-outs and limits the indemnity carve-out solely to IP claims under §9.1(c). It states that recall and bodily-injury exposure is now capped at six months' fees.

Issue 4 describes new §14.4 allowing assignment to Affiliates and successors without consent, notwithstanding §14.3. It notes there are no conditions on the assignee and that the clause is one-way while Harrowgate remains bound by consent. It addresses the competitor risk through the proposed competitor change-of-control termination right.
Issue 8 states that under SA §15.2 and Amend. §5.2 a signed amendment ranks above the Supply Agreement and its changes override SA §§11.2 and 14.3.
Issue 14 quotes the SA §11.1 cap as 'fees paid by Customer in the six months before the claim arose'; Issue 2 states the same.
The memo is addressed to the Supervising Partner and lists 28 issues item by item. Each issue has a 'Where' section citation and a 'Recommended fix'.
It proposes specific language, including a restored §11.2, a narrowed §3.1, a revised §14.4 with competitor change-of-control termination, and others.
It expressly says not to rely on a late objection because the window closed September 2. It does not treat the window as open.
It states that the term sheet is superseded by SA §15.1 and cannot be relied on to narrow §3.1.
